notes.title: Version 1.3 notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The last story level had a bug related to the time stamp. Now you can get it... if you're fast enough :D
[*]Nekomew's new adventure has been announced! [url=https://nekomew.cat/nn]Nekomew's Nightmares[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: About the "Extra mode"
notes.content: After finishing the game without using the "Slow mode" the "Extra mode" (???) will be unlocked. This new mode allows you play the game in different ways. Also, if you beat these levels you'll find out more stuff about Nekomew's story...from a different point of view...

notes.title: Itch.io users
notes.content:
[h1] Itch.io users[/h1]
If you have purchased the game in itch.io a key for the Steam version will be sent to you, so wait for it in your inbox!

notes.title: Itch.io users
notes.content:
[h1] Itch.io users[/h1]
If you have purchased the game in itch.io you can ask for a Steam key sending an email to steamkey@pikewin.com with the subject "Nekomew's Potty Trouble Steam Key"!
